title.narrative: OVOF - Use of Art, Media, and Culture-Bangladesh

description.narrative: OVOF has seen the results of working with artists, media and cultural workers. It helps shiftmental models around gender and sexuality, and disrupts stigma steeped in bias andprejudice. OVOF partners have (effectively) used art and arts-based public campaigns (forexample, film festivals) to change the way people think about highly stigmatised topics suchas sex work, both within feminist movements and in society. Art has the power to reachpeople beyond activist circles and across country borders. Shifting social norms aroundgender and sexuality (both within and outside movements) is critical to OVOF and its workwith artists.

comment.narrative: APC took time to identify interventions that will be beneficial for structurally silenced women and CSOs in each country. As the indicator measures any new values occurring since the start of the intervention,the baseline value is set at 0.

APC aims to do 1 intervention in Bangladesh which looks to build capacity around the use of art, media, and culture by using digital technologies to visibilise alternative narratives of structurally silenced women and their communities.

APC partners organised 1 intervention in Bangladesh around the use of art, media, and culture. These were in the form of digital storytelling workshops where participants produced audio visual stories to share their narratives, and also in the form of content creation workshops where participants created content on queerness, gender, sexuality etc. using different kinds of art and writing.
